high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "english.elpais.com." The article discusses the Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for their work on AlphaFold2, an artificial intelligence system capable of predicting protein structures. The text highlights that AlphaFold2 can predict the intricate structures of all 200 million known proteins in minutes, which was previously a task requiring months of work.
